svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Onkar stands beside three things he builds: high-throughput systems, decentralized protocols, and mobile & 3D interactive UI.

g.text: Full Stack & Web3 Engineer with 5 industry internships by day, anime builder by night.
Scalable MERN & Next.js platforms with multi-tenant isolation, JWT & granular RBAC
Smart contracts, Polygon blockchain & IPFS for verifiable, tamper-proof state
Production React Native apps, Spline 3D interfaces & high-performance animations
“I don't just write code. I engineer my ninja way.”
